desc:
The original ideas for this game are directly from ULTRAKILL by Arsi "Hakita" Patala and SUPERHOT by Superhot Team. Please play those games if you've enjoyed Shatterpoint.

1000 Rivens + 10000 Shards at 300 likes. [THIS HAS BEEN ACHIEVED, GIFTING NEXT UPDATE WITH A 7-DAY CLAIM TIMER SO MAJORITY CAN HAVE A CHANCE TO GET IT! Thanks for all your support!]

[UPCOMING UPDATES]
- A new game mode will be introduced
- Levels 36-40 will be added.
- A new weapon will be added for obtainment.
- Hairstyles will be reworked.

Time is under your control, so long as you don't move. Switch between slowing down time and moving fast to advance through waves of enemies and finish your mission in without fail. Their bodies are nothing but glass infront of your fists.

Shatterpoint is made and owned by umbral studios

If any bugs are found, please report them in the group.
Controls and settings are in the main menu and are further explained in the tutorial level.
